explanation: The body is ∑ over i ∈ range (n+1) with i ∈ D of a i, which is exactly the sum of the deleted terms up to and including index n. This matches the docstring, so the definition is correct as written. It is not a standard object from the literature, though. It is an auxiliary quantity defined only to support the proof's lemmas, for example keptPrefixSum + deletedPrefixSum = fullPrefixSum and monotonicity in D. It works with natural-number sequences because that is the setting of the problem. Since it is an internal proof device rather than a standalone mathematical notion, the verdict is not_a_mathematical_object.
